facts.fact: Gage 揭底：Sarah 会陷入创伤性木僵——小学时发生在她身上的坏事，连新闻媒体都不敢报；家中早已学会以耐心与安静陪她熬过。
facts.anchor: Learned that bad shit had happened to her when she was in elementary school

facts.fact: 深夜告白：Sarah 幸存的那场校园枪击，持枪者是她父亲。
facts.anchor: It was my father, Ethan. He was the one with the gun.

facts.fact: 枪击细节：父亲打倒数名同学，走到她课桌前凝视良久后离开——回家杀死妻子（常遭他殴打）后自尽。
facts.anchor: The shooter had gone home and killed his wife, then himself.

facts.fact: Ethan 与她结对：两个被父亲试图杀死的孩子，两人的母亲都被父亲害死。
facts.anchor: Both with fathers who succeeded with our mothers.

facts.fact: 守夜出发前 Dale 警告：这个 preacher-slash-pastor 让他不安——前信众称该教派视就医为禁忌，与 Johnny 说的完全一致。
facts.anchor: I’ve found claims from previous followers that report medical care is against the religion.

facts.fact: Ethan 趁散场把 Blue 的画像塞进长袍偷走，安抚 Seb：我替你把她的画像带回家了。
facts.anchor: I got your girl. Now chill.

facts.fact: 牧师的崭新奔驰（Blue 的捐款买单）被四人集体「浇灌」——Gage 还尿了门把手；后座发现散落的小玩偶。
facts.anchor: Four angry penises were whipped out and happily pissed all over the car

facts.fact: 终景：数十盏天灯升向天堂，星星在灯间闪烁——Gage 感到一层暖意裹住众人，像一次幽灵的拥抱。
facts.anchor: A shroud of warmth that can only be described as a ghostly embrace.
